name: Wayne Severson
residence: Sweetwater County (he wrote that he is a 37-year county resident)
occupation: Retired business owner, retired state traffic-control supervisor, and master electrician (Green River Star, Oct. 15, 2026, voter-guide statement)
background: Wayne Severson was the Democratic nominee for Sweetwater County commissioner in 2026 and lost the November 3 general election. In a Green River Star general-election voter-guide statement he wrote that he is a 37-year Sweetwater County resident, a retired business owner, a retired state traffic-control supervisor, and a master electrician. He won the Democratic primary and finished behind the three Republican nominees in the general election.
